modules.name: Elemental Revelator
modules.description: Four-element wavetable synth voice — a pentagram of AIR, WATER, EARTH, and FIRE oscillators with elemental-ring cross-modulation, opposing-pair ring mod, SPIRIT chord mode, 72 daemon algorithms, ladder lowpass filter, and stereo delay/diffusion.

modules.name: Moon Phase Distortion
modules.description: Stereo distortion whose depth and character follow the real phase of the moon, with manual override and CV.

modules.name: Liminal Vast Reverb
modules.description: Lush stereo reverb with a modulated, diffused feedback delay network — from intimate rooms to the endless liminal vast, with infinite decay and freeze.

modules.name: Saros
modules.description: Envelope and modulation generator — morphing shape bank, mouse-drawable screen with playhead, time warp and flux, 5 ms to 30 minutes.

modules.name: Sephirothic Modulator
modules.description: Tree of Life planetary CV matrix — ten sephirah outputs computed from real Keplerian orbital positions (Venus pentagram X/Y, Mercury retrograde triggers, lunar phase, planetary clocks), time warp up to x100,000,000, and a Da'at matrix mixer.

modules.name: Cosmic Clock
modules.description: Astrological waveform engine — nine planetary LFO voices shaped by the zodiac signs they transit and mixed by live aspects, with a chart-of-the-moment wheel, end-of-cycle triggers, and time warp up to x100,000,000.

modules.name: Coronal Annihilator
modules.description: Stereo voice: a complex dual oscillator (CORE drives FLARE with FM, sync, wavefolding and phase warp) blended with an external stereo input, through an onboard neural amp model (.nam, one network per channel) and a saturating 4-pole lowpass with 12/24 dB slopes.

modules.name: Litany Engine
modules.description: Looping sample player with an onboard litany of loops and a focused granular engine — or load your own sample folder: through-zero varispeed, grain size from whole-loop down to 15 ms, morphing overlap, scan and texture spray; stereo companion to the Coronal Annihilator's external input.
